title: Santa Totem Mini
description: Santa Totem Mini is a lightweight resource pack that turns the Totem of Undying into a festive Santa design. Clean, simple, and optimized for modern Minecraft versions.
body: Santa Totem Mini replaces the Totem of Undying with a festive Santa-themed design. It’s lightweight, clean, and made to keep the vanilla feel while adding a fun holiday twist. Optimized for modern Minecraft versions.
